items.title: RED: reproduce candidate-authority, identity, lineage, and recall failures
items.context: Before implementation, create executable failing evidence showing raw detector signals crossing authority boundaries, repeated observations producing unstable or duplicate defects, historical corrections losing their predecessors, and recall/index queries missing or resurfacing invalid entries.

items.title: Separate CandidateFinding signals from canonical defect authority
items.context: Define CandidateFinding as non-authoritative detector output with detector provenance and normalized signal fields. Promotion to a canonical defect must be explicit, evidence-bound, deterministic, and unable to bypass later assessment or gate predicates.

items.title: Implement canonical defect identity and non-gate route receipts
items.context: Create stable canonicalDefectId rules, bounded matching, collision isolation, and auditable routing receipts that remain non-authoritative until the applicability Story consumes them.

items.title: Implement supersession chains and historical recall indexes
items.context: Preserve immutable predecessor links, reject cycles or ambiguous forks, index current and historical observations, suppress superseded entries by default, and allow explicit lineage retrieval and correction audit.

items.title: GREEN: prove identity isolation, lineage correctness, and recall
items.context: Turn every RED case GREEN and add adversarial collision, deterministic replay, concurrent promotion, CAS rejection, supersession-cycle, correction-chain, recall, migration, dependency-boundary, scorecard, and rollback verification.
